items.source: @DynamicMapping and @DynamicMappingValue have been removed. Use @Document.dynamic or @Field.dynamic instead.
items.translation: @DynamicMapping 和 @DynamicMappingValue 已被移除。请使用 @Document.dynamic 或 @Field.dynamic 替代。

items.source: an ElasticsearchOperations bean, available with the bean names elasticsearchOperations and elasticsearchTemplate, this uses the ElasticsearchClient
items.translation: 一个名为 elasticsearchOperations 和 elasticsearchTemplate 的 ElasticsearchOperations Bean，它使用 ElasticsearchClient。

items.source: an ReactiveElasticsearchOperations bean, available with the bean names reactiveElasticsearchOperations and reactiveElasticsearchTemplate, this uses the ReactiveElasticsearchClient
items.translation: 一个名为 reactiveElasticsearchOperations 和 reactiveElasticsearchTemplate 的 ReactiveElasticsearchOperations Bean，它使用 ReactiveElasticsearchClient。

items.source: Logging by setting the property logging.level.org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.WIRE=trace is deprecated now, the Elasticsearch RestClient provides a better solution that can be activated by setting the logging level of the tracer package to "trace".
items.translation: 通过设置属性logging.level.org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.WIRE=trace进行日志记录现已弃用，Elasticsearch 的RestClient提供了更好的解决方案，可以通过将tracer包的日志级别设置为"trace"来激活该方案。

items.source: When working with the NativeSearchQuery class, you’ll need to switch to the NativeQuery class, which can take a Query instance coming from the new Elasticsearch client libraries. You’ll find plenty of examples in the test code.
items.translation: 在使用 NativeSearchQuery 类时，您需要切换到 NativeQuery 类，该类可以接受来自新 Elasticsearch 客户端库的 Query 实例。您可以在测试代码中找到大量相关示例。

items.source: The following classes have been converted to Record, you might need to adjust the use of getter methods from getProp() to prop():
items.translation: 以下类已转换为 `Record`，您可能需要调整对获取器方法的使用，从`getProp()`改为`prop()`：

items.source: Hint: You can pass a org.springframework.http .HttpHeaders to the addAll() method of org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.support.HttpHeaders.
items.translation: 提示：您可以将org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders传递给org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.support.HttpHeaders的addAll()方法。

items.source: See Package changes, all classes in this package have been deprecated, as the default client implementations to use are the ones based on the new Java Client from Elasticsearch, see New Elasticsearch client
items.translation: 参见包变更，此包中的所有类均已弃用，因为默认应使用的客户端实现是基于 Elasticsearch 新 Java Client 的版本，详见新的 Elasticsearch 客户端。

items.source: DateFormat.none and DateFormat.custom had been deprecated since version 4.2 and have been removed.
items.translation: 自版本 4.2 起，DateFormat.none 和 DateFormat.custom 已被弃用并已移除。

items.source: The properties of @Document that were deprecated since 4.2 have been removed. Use the @Settings annotation for these.
items.translation: 自 4.2 版本起已弃用的 @Document 属性已被移除。请使用 @Settings 注解来替代这些功能。

items.source: Both SearchOperations and ReactiveSearchOperations had deprecated calls that were using Elasticsearch classes as parameters. These now have been removed and so the dependency on Elasticsearch classes in these APIs has been cleaned.
items.translation: `SearchOperations` 和 `ReactiveSearchOperations` 中此前存在使用 Elasticsearch 类作为参数的已弃用调用，现已移除。因此，这些 API 对 Elasticsearch 类的依赖关系已被清理。

items.source: All the classes that are using or depend on the deprecated Elasticsearch RestHighLevelClient have been moved to the package org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.erhlc. By this change we now have a clear separation of code using the old deprecated Elasticsearch libraries, code using the new Elasticsearch client and code that is independent of the client implementation. Also the reactive implementation that was provided up to now has been moved here, as this implementation contains code that was copied and adapted from Elasticsearch libraries.
items.translation: 所有使用或依赖已过时的 Elasticsearch RestHighLevelClient 的类已移至包 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.erhlc。 通过此次更改，我们实现了清晰的分隔：使用旧版已过时 Elasticsearch 库的代码、使用新版 Elasticsearch 客户端的代码，以及独立于客户端实现的代码。 此外，此前提供的响应式实现也已移至此处，因为该实现包含从 Elasticsearch 库复制和适配的代码。

items.source: If you are using ElasticsearchRestTemplate directly and not the ElasticsearchOperations interface you’ll need to adjust your imports as well.
items.translation: 如果您直接使用 ElasticsearchRestTemplate 而非 ElasticsearchOperations 接口，您还需要相应地调整导入语句。

items.source: Until version 4.4 the client configuration used the HttpHeaders class from the org.springframework:spring-web project. This introduces a dependency on that artifact. Users that do not use spring-web then face an error as this class cannot be found.
items.translation: 在 4.4 版本之前，客户端配置使用的是来自 `org.springframework:spring-web` 项目的 `HttpHeaders` 类。这引入了对该构件的依赖。对于不使用 spring-web 的用户来说，由于找不到该类，将会遇到错误。

items.source: So if you are using headers in the client configuration, you need to replace org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders with org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.support.HttpHeaders.
items.translation: 因此，如果您在客户端配置中使用请求头，需要将org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders替换为org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.support.HttpHeaders。

items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch now uses the new ElasticsearchClient and has deprecated the use of the previous RestHighLevelClient.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 现已采用新的 ElasticsearchClient，并弃用了之前使用的 RestHighLevelClient。

items.source: an ElasticsearchClient bean, this is the new client that uses the RestClient
items.translation: 一个 `ElasticsearchClient` Bean，这是使用 `RestClient` 的新客户端。

items.source: an ReactiveElasticsearchClient bean, this is the new reactive client that uses the RestClient
items.translation: 一个 `ReactiveElasticsearchClient` Bean，这是使用 `RestClient` 的新响应式客户端。

items.source: In version 5.0 we introduce our own HttpHeaders to configure the clients.
items.translation: 在 5.0 版本中，我们引入了自己的 `<code>HttpHeaders` 来配置客户端。

items.translation: 要配置 Spring Data Elasticsearch 使用新客户端，需要创建一个继承自org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.client.elc.ElasticsearchConfiguration的配置 Bean：

items.source: The old deprecated RestHighLevelClient can still be used, but you will need to add the dependency explicitly to your application as Spring Data Elasticsearch does not pull it in automatically anymore:
items.translation: 旧的已弃用的RestHighLevelClient仍然可以使用，但您需要显式地将该依赖添加到您的应用程序中，因为 Spring Data Elasticsearch 不再自动引入它：
